newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kanematsu says to write off 40 bln yen in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Kanematsu says to write off 40 bln yen in 1996/97.

text.p: Kanematsu Corp said on Thursday that it expected to write off 40 billion yen in the year ending March 31, 1997, due to losses on financial investments and the winding up of some affiliates.
The trading house said in a statement that it had lowered its forecast for parent and group earnings for the year as a result of the expected write-off.
Kanematsu said it had decided to get out of loss-making financial investments and said it expected to lose about 15 billion yen in the process.
Kanematsu had also reviewed its overall business and decided to close some of its affiliates and dispose of loss-making securities holdings, it said.
Kanematsu said it would post a parent net loss of five billion yen in the six months to September 30 against its previous forecast of net profit of 800 million yen.
The company said it would post a full-year parent net loss of 20 billion yen, against its previous forecast of a net profit of two billion yen.
